{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue_clean == 999999.99
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Filter: only completed orders, exclude QA orders
filtered_sales = sales.loc[~qa_mask & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Confirm final population
print(f'Final number of completed orders (excluding QA): {len(filtered_sales)}')

# Compute conversion rate by channel and customer_segment
conversion_rates = filtered_sales.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()
print('Conversion rates by channel and segment:')
print(conversion_rates)

# Compute marginal distribution of customer_segment within each channel
segment_dist = filtered_sales.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().reset_index(name='count')
segment_dist = segment_dist.merge(conversion_rates, on=['channel', 'customer_segment'])

# Compute weighted average conversion rate per channel (weighted by segment size)
weighted_conv_rate = segment_dist.groupby('channel').apply(
    lambda x: (x['count'] * x['converted']).sum() / x['count'].sum()
).reset_index(name='weighted_conversion_rate')

print('\nWeighted conversion rates by channel:')
print(weighted_conv_rate)

# Compute difference: email - paid_search
email_rate = weighted_conv_rate[weighted_conv_rate['channel'] == 'email']['weighted_conversion_rate'].values[0]
paid_search_rate = weighted_conv_rate[weighted_conv_rate['channel'] == 'paid_search']['weighted_conversion_rate'].values[0]
effect = email_rate - paid_search_rate

print(f'\nEffect (email - paid_search): {effect:.6f}')"}
